thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we had three correlated issues (missing spans, bad aggregation, ETL lag). Need clear owners and timelines. Who can own remediation tracking?
kevin: I can take ETL lag. I'll scope an investigation this week. Tentative ETA: 2w for fix + 1w for validation.
priya: I'll handle spans instrumentation gaps. I want to add sampling and end-to-end tests. ETA: next sprint (10 business days).
tom: I'll cover aggregation correctness and the alerting rules. I think we need a new alert that fires on distribution drift, not just sums. ETA: 3 days for alert, 2w for robustness work.
jen: I'll coordinate and keep the postmortem action tracker updated. Can everyone paste Jira IDs once created? Also I'll schedule weekly 30m check-ins until signoff.
kevin: creating tickets now: INF-3728 (ETL root cause), INF-3729 (ETL retries/backfill plan).
priya: INF-3730 (span instrumentation coverage), INF-3731 (integration tests for trace propagation).
tom: INF-3732 (aggregation alerting), INF-3733 (agg-edge-case tests).
ops-bot: New doc added: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-observability-runbook — linked from the thread.
maria: Good. Priorities: 1) stopgap alerts so product owners notice, 2) fixes + backfill, 3) test coverage to prevent regressions.
jen: I've added owners and dates to the tracker. Weekly check-ins Fridays 10am starting next week.
kevin: For ETL lag, first action is to add per-stage latency metrics + create a dashboard. I'll post the dashboard link by EOD tomorrow.
priya: For spans, I've identified two services missing client-side instrumentation — will open PRs.
tom: For aggregation drift, I'm adding a canary dataset versioning step so we can compare old vs new pipeline outputs automatically.
maria: One more ask — please add a short blameless note in each ticket about recurrence pattern and link to past incidents (INF-3110, INF-3245). We want trend visibility.
jen: Noted. I'll also add a recurring monthly audit item to the roadmap to detect patterns across incidents.
kevin: Quick Q: do we want the weekly check-ins to include SRE + product analytics + infra?
maria: Yes — keep them narrow: SRE, Eng Analytics, and one PM for impacted product.
jen: OK added attendees. I'll send the invite.
priya: n1 on tests — will add synthetic trace generator so we can validate spans end-to-end in CI.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook template updated. See /docs/observability/runbooks.
maria: Thanks everyone. If anything slips, flag it in the tracker and escalate in #eng-oncall.
kevin: Will do.
jen: Closing thread for now — we'll use the weekly to surface blockers. :thumbsup:
